source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt:
Wide cinematic 16:9 image of a futuristic pharmaceutical research room blended with a cozy vintage apothecary, photorealistic high-end 3D rendering. A brushed stainless-steel worktable fills the foreground, reflecting teal neon and warm amber light. Centered above the table floats a luminous DNA double helix constructed from transparent turquoise glass molecular nodes, slender glowing cyan bonds, and occasional metallic gold spheres, with a small polygonal molecular branch extending toward the lower right.

On the left, a large transparent holographic panel in perspective has a thin cyan illuminated border. Its bold white heading reads “EvidenceGrade AI”, with “5-tier grade” below. Five vertically stacked outlined grading boxes display “A”, “B”, “C”, “D”, “F”, colored green, cyan, yellow, orange, and red respectively. Beside them is a fine white grid chart titled “Citation Confidence 2019-2026”, with vertical-axis labels “0”, “10”, “20”, “30”, “40”, “50”, “60”, and an irregular cyan line rising from near zero toward fifty. The bottom chart label also reads “Citation Confidence 2019-2026”.

Foreground left: an open cream-colored spiral notebook on a brown leather folio, with a dark green and gold fountain pen resting diagonally on its right page. Handwritten words read “CYP3A4 interaction risk”; the remaining small handwriting is unreadable. Foreground right: an off-white ceramic cup with delicate dark crackle lines, a teal travel lid, and a matching saucer.

Background shelves hold amber medicine bottles with white labels, including “Aspirin”, “Warfarin”, and “Ibuprofen”, along with pale upright binders and a small test-tube rack. An antique brass microscope stands on the rear counter, beside a potted monstera with green and yellow leaves. Overhead, articulated brass industrial lamps with metal shades and one green enamel shade cast warm pools of light.

At right, a tall arched black-framed window looks onto a rainy neon-lit East Asian street. Pink, red, and cyan vertical signs glow through rain-streaked glass; their Chinese characters are too indistinct to transcribe reliably. Wet pavement reflects the signs. A black cat sits on the windowsill, and a folded deep-red umbrella with a curved wooden handle leans below it. Dark teal walls, subtle atmospheric haze, realistic glass refraction, soft volumetric lighting, detailed material textures, quiet nocturnal atmosphere, cool turquoise shadows balanced against warm golden highlights.
